note: 52 new incl. 35 small-venue gigs, 4 prices filled, 2 now sold out.

events.description: One of Switzerland's most recognisable voices for 15 years, Basel's Anna Rossinelli tours her album 'Heat' with a full band – new songs meet familiar hits, electronic beats alternate with stripped-back acoustic moments. Show 20:00 at Papiersaal in Sihlcity (easy parking in the Sihlcity garage).
events.summary: Swiss soul-pop voice Anna Rossinelli (The Voice coach, 'Tschugger') brings her new album 'Heat' to intimate Papiersaal.
events.title: Anna Rossinelli – Heat Tour 2026

events.description: Every autumn the Bächlihof farm in Rapperswil-Jona hosts the Swiss championship for weighing giant pumpkins and vegetables, alongside its big pumpkin exhibition (12 Sept–1 Nov). Kids can marvel at monster squashes, then pick and decorate pumpkins on the farm. Entry CHF 10 at weekends, children under 12 free; 25 minutes from Küsnacht by car or S-Bahn to Jona.
events.summary: Giant pumpkins hit the scales at the Swiss championship on a lakeside pumpkin farm in Jona – pure autumn spectacle for kids.
events.title: Swiss Pumpkin & Vegetable Weighing Championship at Bächlihof

events.description: Ballett Zürich director Cathy Marston sets 'Ein Sommernachtstraum' on a derelict carnival ground, pairing Mendelssohn's famous score with Gabriel Prokofiev's Concerto for Turntables, played live by DJ Mr. Switch and the Philharmonia Zürich. Premiere 11 Oct, further shows 16, 18, 25, 28, 29, 31 Oct and 12–14 Nov 2026 (plus June 2027). No language barrier; a perfect date night, and the fairground setting could hook older kids too.
events.summary: Shakespeare's comedy danced on an abandoned fairground, with Mendelssohn plus a live turntablist – ballet with a twist.
events.title: A Midsummer Night's Dream – Ballett Zürich premiere (Cathy Marston)

events.description: Beth Hart – the LA singer famed for her Joe Bonamassa collaborations and Royal Albert Hall shows – plays blues rock, soul and ballads. Doors 18:30, show 20:00; ZVV public-transport ticket included, and raclette dinner packages can be added via Ticketcorner. The Hall sits right by Stettbach station.
events.summary: Blues-rock's most ferocious voice brings the 'You Still Got Me' tour to The Hall.
events.title: Beth Hart

events.description: Comedy Kiss brings British TV favourites Sara Pascoe (Taskmaster, QI) and Scotland's Larry Dean, plus Frankie Monroe, to the Volkshaus Weisser Saal. All in English, recommended 16+. Doors 19:00, show 20:00–22:30 – a great expat date night.
events.summary: Top UK stand-up in English: Sara Pascoe and Larry Dean headline Comedy Kiss's biggest Zurich night.
events.title: The Biggest Comedy Kiss: Sara Pascoe, Larry Dean & Frankie Monroe

events.description: Josh Edwards aka Blanco White fuses British singer-songwriter craft with Andalusian and Andean influences (debut album 'On the Other Side'). A hushed, beautiful evening for folk and Americana fans in the Volkshaus, 19:30.
events.summary: London songwriter Blanco White weaves flamenco guitar and charango into ethereal acoustic folk.
events.title: Blanco White

events.description: Bombino has worked with Keith Richards and Dan Auerbach and fuses Tuareg music traditions with Hendrix- and Dire Straits-style guitar. Support comes from 3YOONI (CH). Doors 19:00, start 19:45; Salzhaus is a 5-min walk from Winterthur station.
events.summary: Niger's Grammy-nominated 'Sultan of Shred' brings hypnotic Tuareg desert-blues guitar to the Salzhaus.
events.title: Bombino at Salzhaus Winterthur

events.description: A solo piano recital built on Wesseltoft's classic 'It's Still Snowing On My Piano' – delicate, peaceful, pre-Christmas jazz. It's his only Swiss concert. Doors 19:30, start 20:00; unnumbered seating in three zones (front nave, gallery, rear nave), so arrive early for the best spots. Tickets via Ticketcorner only.
events.summary: Norwegian jazz pianist Bugge Wesseltoft plays his beloved wintry solo album in candle-lit Neumünster church.
events.title: Bugge Wesseltoft – It's Still Snowing On My Piano

events.description: Season opener of the municipal 'Konzerte in Küsnacht' series: the Casal Quartett performs works by Mozart, Pēteris Vasks and Beethoven. Entry is free with a collection, but seating in the Seehof Festsaal is limited, so arrive at doors (16:30). A relaxed Sunday-afternoon concert that works for older kids too.
events.summary: Top Swiss string quartet plays Mozart, Vasks and Beethoven in Küsnacht's lakeside Seehof – free, Sunday 5pm.
events.title: Casal Quartett – Konzerte in Küsnacht

events.description: Alec Ounsworth's Philadelphia indie band, famous for their self-released 2005 debut and its yelping anthems, play Bogen F under the Viadukt. Show 20:30, CHF 40. Presale starts 30.09.2026 at 11:00 via Bogen F (Petzi/See Tickets) – small room, so grab tickets early.
events.summary: 2000s blog-rock heroes Clap Your Hands Say Yeah return to the snug Bogen F viaduct arch – presale opens 30 Sept.
events.title: Clap Your Hands Say Yeah

events.description: Constantini moves between piano and bandoneón, blending classical music with tango – from Astor Piazzolla to his own compositions and improvisations. Only Swiss concert; doors 19:30, start 20:00, free seating in three price zones. Tickets via Ticketcorner.
events.summary: Peruvian piano and bandoneón virtuoso Claudio Constantini brings tango-meets-classical to Neumünster church.
events.title: Claudio Constantini

events.description: Belfast rock trio Dea Matrona (Orla McKeown, Mollie McGinn and drummer Holly Hodge) channel Fleetwood Mac and Led Zeppelin-era classic rock with three-part harmonies and twin-guitar fireworks – a treat for parents who grew up on legacy rock. Friday night at Papiersaal in Sihlcity; tickets CHF 36.60 via Ticketcorner. Start time not yet published.
events.summary: Belfast trio Dea Matrona bring 70s-style guitar rock, big harmonies and blazing solos to Papiersaal.
events.title: Dea Matrona

events.description: Die Ärzte (Farin Urlaub, Bela B, Rod) have been filling arenas since the 80s with 'Schrei nach Liebe', 'Männer sind Schweine' and 'Westerland'. Two nights in Zürich (19 & 20 May 2027); this entry is the 20 May show, which still had tickets. Early start: doors 16:30, show 18:30. Standing CHF 95, seats from CHF 80.
events.summary: 'Die beste Band der Welt' – Berlin punk-pop icons Die Ärzte play the Hallenstadion (2nd night added).
events.title: Die Ärzte – Eine Gänsehaut nach dem andern!

events.description: Fanta 4 – 'Die da!?', 'MfG', 'Tag am Meer' – are calling it a day with 'Der letzte Bus', their farewell tour. Pure 90s nostalgia in the Hallenstadion; doors 18:00, show 20:00. Standing and seated tickets via Ticketcorner.
events.summary: The German hip-hop legends behind 'Die da!?' say goodbye after 36 years on their final tour.
events.title: Die Fantastischen Vier – Der letzte Bus (final tour)

events.description: Leipzig's Die Prinzen, the best-selling German band of the early 90s, bring their farewell tour to the Hallenstadion. Expect 'Millionär', 'Alles nur geklaut' and 'Du musst ein Schwein sein' – fun for parents and catchy enough for kids. Doors 18:00, show 19:30.
events.summary: The a-cappella-pop heroes of 'Alles nur geklaut' and 'Küssen verboten' take their final bow.
events.title: Die Prinzen – Tschüssi, macht's gut! (farewell tour)

events.description: A festive 70-minute Advent Sunday show: the Zurich Jazz Orchestra (directed by Ed Partyka) plays Duke Ellington's jazz take on Tchaikovsky's Nutcracker, interwoven with E.T.A. Hoffmann's story read in German. An original Rigiblick production (no tribute) and an early 18:00 start that works for older kids too.
events.summary: Zurich Jazz Orchestra swings Ellington's Nutcracker while Klaus Henner Russius reads the Hoffmann tale.
events.title: Duke Ellington's Nussknacker Suite

events.description: Falstaff's sparkling-wine festival brings leading producers of Champagne, Sekt, Crémant, Prosecco, Franciacorta and Cava to the Ameron Bellerive au Lac. Tickets include all tastings plus appetizers; public entry from 16:30. Book ahead – advance CHF 59 vs CHF 89 at the door. Minimum age 16.
events.summary: Champagne, Franciacorta, Crémant and Cava from top producers in a lakeside hotel on Utoquai – a fizzy after-work date.
events.title: Falstaff Sparkling Wine Festival Zürich

events.description: Bogotá's Frente Cumbiero – clarinet, sax, euphonium, percussion and electronics – play a special 50–65 minute family show at kid-appropriate volume (ear protection still recommended for little ones). Doors 10:30, show 11:00. Adults CHF 30, ages 12–16 CHF 15, under-12s free but must be reserved. High-demand event, so reserve early.
events.priceText: CHF 30 (12–16 CHF 15, under 12 free with reservation)
events.summary: Sunday-morning family cumbia party at Moods: Colombia's new-cumbia pioneers play a kid-friendly 1-hour set.
events.title: Frente Cumbiero für Familien

events.description: GC host Lausanne-Sport on the weekend of 7–8 November; the Swiss Football League confirms the exact day and kick-off. A relaxed fixture that suits a first match for the kids.
events.priceText: CHF 25–65 (adults CHF 50–65, U16 half price, under 6 free)
events.summary: Early-November Super League football with GC at home in the Letzigrund.
events.title: Grasshoppers vs FC Lausanne-Sport

events.description: GC host FC Vaduz on the weekend of 31 October–1 November; the exact day and time are confirmed by the Swiss Football League. Easier-to-get tickets make it a relaxed first stadium visit for the kids.
events.priceText: CHF 25–65 (adults CHF 50–65, U16 half price, under 6 free)
events.summary: A Halloween-weekend Super League match: GC against Liechtenstein's FC Vaduz at the Letzigrund.
events.title: Grasshoppers vs FC Vaduz

events.description: Grasshopper Club Zürich host Young Boys, one of the season's bigger fixtures, at their shared home, the Letzigrund. Sunday matches are easy to fit in with family plans. The kick-off time is confirmed by the Swiss Football League.
events.priceText: CHF 25–65 (adults CHF 50–65, U16 half price, under 6 free)
events.summary: Sunday football: Zurich's record champions GC take on the Bern giants YB at the Letzigrund.
events.title: Grasshoppers vs BSC Young Boys

events.description: German indie auteur Konstantin Gropper's Get Well Soon is known for cinematic, string-laden chamber pop and melancholy singer-songwriter craft (plus film scores). Show 20:30 in the small Bogen F arch at Viadukt, CHF 42 via Petzi or Ticketcorner.
events.summary: Konstantin Gropper's lush, orchestral indie-pop project Get Well Soon plays an intimate Saturday at Bogen F.
events.title: Get Well Soon

events.description: Nannini's 80s hits made her a star across the German-speaking world too, and her Zurich shows draw a big Italian-Swiss crowd. Hallenstadion, autumn 2027.
events.priceText: Price TBA · general sale opened 28 Sep via Ticketcorner
events.summary: Italian rock queen Gianna Nannini ('Bello e impossibile', 'I maschi') — raspy 80s anthems in Hallenstadion.
events.title: Gianna Nannini

events.description: Giant Rooks from Hamm play indie pop/rock with art-pop flourishes and huge sing-along choruses ('Wild Stare', 'Morning Blue'). Sunday evening show at the 3,500-capacity Halle 622 next to Zürich Oerlikon station. Tickets via Ticketcorner.
events.summary: Germany's biggest indie-pop export brings its soaring anthems to Oerlikon's Halle 622.
events.title: Giant Rooks

events.description: Ginny Loon's songs draw on her busking travels around Europe – storms and the silence after, highs and lows, friendship and celebration. This Albani show is the release of her album 'Yellow & Blue'. Doors 19:00, start 20:00; presale CHF 25.
events.summary: Swiss indie-folk singer with an unmistakable voice launches her album after years busking across Europe.
events.title: Ginny Loon – 'Yellow & Blue' album release at Albani

events.description: Mama Shelter in Zürich-West hosts a bilingual (German/English) Halloween afternoon for kids: 'Paint it. Create it. Eat it!' edible masterpieces, professional spooky make-up and a creative colouring corner. Price includes all activities plus one drink for a parent; stay for dinner in the restaurant afterwards.
events.summary: Paint-and-eat edible art, spooky face paint by a pro make-up artist and Halloween colouring – while parents get a coffee.
events.title: Halloween Kids Party at Mama Shelter

events.description: Jack Savoretti's warm, retro singer-songwriter pop is ideal date-night listening. Kaufleuten bills this as his sole Swiss show, so expect demand. Central location near Paradeplatz.
events.summary: Velvet-voiced English-Italian crooner Jack Savoretti's only Swiss show, in cosy Kaufleuten.
events.title: Jack Savoretti

events.description: Jon Cleary – sideman to Bonnie Raitt and Taj Mahal and a Grammy winner in his own right – leads a six-piece band with horns and percussion through rolling New Orleans funk-soul-blues. Doors 19:00, show 20:00–22:00. Choose standing (CHF 65), seated (CHF 90) or the premium seat + dinner package (CHF 135).
events.summary: Grammy-winning New Orleans piano man Jon Cleary brings funk, soul and blues to the Klubsaal.
events.title: Jon Cleary & The Absolute Monster Gentlemen

events.description: British music legend Jools Holland (Squeeze, BBC 'Later… with Jools Holland' since 1992) brings his boogie-woogie, blues and R&B set with Dave Swift (bass), Ed Richardson (drums), Ruby Turner and Louise Marshall on vocals. A rare chance to see him in a club this size. Doors 19:30, show 20:30; CHF 55 (members half price) – high-demand, book now.
events.summary: Squeeze co-founder and 'Later…' host Jools Holland pounds out boogie-woogie with soul queen Ruby Turner in a jazz club.
events.title: An Evening with Jools Holland with Special Guest Ruby Turner

events.description: Judith Hill brings her gospel-charged blend of soul, funk and personal storytelling to the Klubsaal. Standing-room show; doors 19:00, music at 20:00. The Kaufleuten restaurant opens at 18:00 for dinner beforehand, and tickets bought on kaufleuten.ch carry no booking fee.
events.summary: Grammy-winning soul-funk powerhouse (ex-Prince collaborator) in Kaufleuten's intimate Klubsaal.
events.title: Judith Hill

events.description: Kalandra blend Nordic folk with alternative rock – fragile, ethereal melodies over dark, cinematic soundscapes (they're on the 'Kingdom Two Crowns: Norse Lands' soundtrack). This tour presents new album 'The Other Side'; special guest Finnegan Tui. Doors 19:00, show 20:00, ends around 22:30.
events.summary: Norwegian band Kalandra weave Nordic folklore and ethereal vocals into atmospheric folk-rock at Dynamo.
events.title: Kalandra – The Other Side Release Tour 2027

events.description: Küsnacht's Kunsteisbahn KEK opens on Sat 24 October 2026 and runs until 7 March 2027. The open field ('Schlittschüendle') is open daily for public skating (weekends 09:00–18:45, weekday afternoons), and the ice hall has afternoon sessions plus Wednesday evenings to 21:30. The easiest after-school winter activity for Gold Coast kids.
events.summary: Your home rink: public skating in Küsnacht from late October, open-air ice plus an indoor hall.
events.title: KEK Küsnacht Ice Rink Season Opens

events.description: Kim Wilde, one of the defining voices of British 80s pop, plays the Volkshaus Theatersaal on her Closer Tour, mixing new songs with the big hits like 'Kids in America' and 'You Keep Me Hangin' On'. Show starts 20:00. A classic nostalgia date night for the parents.
events.summary: 80s pop icon Kim Wilde ('Kids in America', 'Cambodia') brings her Closer Tour to the Volkshaus.
events.title: Kim Wilde – Closer Tour

events.description: Kühnrad Lohse play introspective, emotionally direct rock songs full of humour and wordplay about life's big and small questions; Swiss singer Lavinia opens. Albani is a small, standing-room music club in Winterthur's old town, 25 min by S-Bahn from Zurich HB. Doors 19:00, show 20:00; presale is cheaper than the door.
events.summary: Swiss 'troubadour rock' band with wry, heartfelt German-language songs in Winterthur's cosy old-town club.
events.title: Kühnrad Lohse + Lavinia at Albani

events.description: The Museum of Human Evolution runs its Halloween workshop for children aged 7–12: a creepy-fun tour of skeletons, skulls and bones, then a spooky craft plus treats and drinks. An adult must stay in the museum. Book via Eventfrog; an English-language session is also offered on Fri 30 Oct – ideal for Liam & Ellie.
events.summary: Kids 7–12 explore skeletons, skulls and a real mummy, then craft something spooky to take home – costumes welcome.
events.title: Halloween at KULTURAMA – skeletons & mummy workshop

events.description: Marking 100 years since Hildegard Knef's birth, Michael von der Heide revisits her sharp, witty chansons ('Für mich soll's rote Rosen regnen') with jazz-tinged band arrangements. Classic Rössli evening: 20:30 start, small room, reduced CHF 33 for AHV/students.
events.summary: Swiss chansonnier Michael von der Heide and band celebrate Hildegard Knef's centenary with jazzy chansons.
events.title: Michael von der Heide sings Hildegard Knef

events.description: Dominican piano virtuoso Michel Camilo plays with Ricky Rodriguez (bass) and Antonio Sánchez (drums, of 'Birdman' soundtrack fame) in the Tonhalle's grand hall – the trio's only Swiss date. Presented by AllBlues; doors 19:00, show 20:00, no support act. An elegant Saturday date night.
events.summary: Latin-jazz piano fireworks in the gilded Tonhalle – Camilo's only Swiss concert, with Birdman drummer Antonio Sánchez.
events.title: Michel Camilo Trio feat. Antonio Sánchez

events.description: After two years of intimate acoustic sets, the Berlin-based US/Italian/British trio behind 'Brother' is back with the full band and new songs written for the stage. Harmonies, banjo and big singalong folk-rock in the Volkshaus Theatersaal, 20:00.
events.summary: Indie-folk favourites Mighty Oaks return to Zürich with full band and full energy.
events.title: Mighty Oaks

events.description: The Atlanta band that pioneered the explosive rock-soul-funk crossover returns with singer Joyce Kennedy for a sweaty, joyous standing show. Doors 19:00, start 20:00, ends around 22:00; the Kaufleuten restaurant opens at 18:00. Reduced tickets CHF 48 for students/KulturLegi.
events.summary: 70s funk-rock legends Mother's Finest, fronted by Joyce Kennedy, tear up the Kaufleuten Klubsaal.
events.title: Mother's Finest

events.description: Sophie Lindinger, Mira Lu Kovacs and Nastasja Ronck mix rough, loud guitars with surprisingly sweet three-part harmonies – Rolling Stone called it 'consistent post-punk with love for pop melody'. Doors 19:00, show 20:00 in the small Exil club (16+).
events.summary: Vienna indie supergroup My Ugly Clementine – post-punk bite with sweet pop harmonies – at Exil.
events.title: My Ugly Clementine

events.description: Noah Parks is a classic songwriter blending 70s influences like James Taylor and Billy Joel with contemporary indie-pop. Part of Kammgarn's Wohnzimmer series, with sofas in the front rows for a cosy seated evening. Doors 20:00, concert 20:30; 16+. Schaffhausen is ~40 min by train from Zurich.
events.summary: Swiss songwriter in the James Taylor/Billy Joel mould, played on sofas in Kammgarn's 'living-room' series.
events.title: Noah Parks – Wohnzimmer concert at Kammgarn

events.description: Aleko, The Miserly Knight and Francesca da Rimini are rarely performed, let alone together. General music director Gianandrea Noseda conducts this new production. Surtitles are in German and English.
events.summary: Date night: Zurich Opera stages all three Rachmaninoff one-acters in a single evening, conducted by Gianandrea Noseda.
events.title: Rachmaninoff – The Three Operas (premiere)

events.description: Interlaken friends Ritschi (voice of 90s/2000s Swiss band Plüsch) and Hunzi play an intimate duo set of their own songs and beloved covers, leaving room for spontaneous moments. 20:30 at the Rössli; reduced CHF 43 for AHV/students.
events.summary: Plüsch frontman Ritschi and friend Hunzi: two voices, 73 keys, Mundart songs and favourite covers up close.
events.title: Ritschi & Hunzi – Tagebuch

events.description: Part of the municipal 'Konzerte in Küsnacht' series: SäntisBarock performs 'Flammende Rose' with Baroque works by Telemann, Handel and others. Free with a collection; limited seats in the Seehof Festsaal, doors 16:30. Short walk from Küsnacht station.
events.summary: Baroque ensemble SäntisBarock plays Telemann and Handel in Küsnacht's Seehof – free entry, Sunday 5pm.
events.title: SäntisBarock – 'Flammende Rose'

events.description: The Sam Singers deliver jazzy four-part close harmony on swinging melodies and evergreen hits of the early 20th century. A 17:00 Sunday start at the intimate Rössli makes it an easy early evening out (or with grandparents). Reduced CHF 30 for AHV/students.
events.summary: Switzerland's leading close-harmony quartet swings through golden-age hits on a Sunday afternoon in Stäfa.
events.title: The Sam Singers – Best of

events.description: Scala & Kolacny Brothers turn pop and rock hits into spine-tingling choral arrangements with piano ('Creep', 'Smells Like Teen Spirit', 'Enjoy the Silence'). The 30th-anniversary show adds subtle visuals and choreography. Seated in the Volkshaus Theatersaal – a lovely 90s-flavoured date night.
events.summary: The Belgian girls' choir famous for haunting covers of Radiohead, Nirvana and Depeche Mode celebrates 30 years.
events.title: Scala & Kolacny Brothers – SCALA 30

events.description: Soft Machine, the pioneering British prog/jazz-rock band founded in 1966, play the small Foyer room at Gaswerk Kulturzentrum. Expect long instrumental fusion pieces rooted in the classic 70s catalogue. Show 20:30; tickets via Petzi, slightly more at the door.
events.summary: Canterbury-scene legends Soft Machine bring their jazz-rock fusion to Gaswerk's intimate foyer stage.
events.title: Soft Machine at Gaswerk Winterthur

events.description: Indiana-born singer-songwriter Stephen Wilson Jr. fuses Americana, country and 90s alt-rock grit into raw, literate songs (his album 'son of dad' was a critics' favourite). He plays the Volkshaus Theatersaal at 20:00 – a strong pick for roots/americana fans.
events.summary: Gritty Americana storyteller Stephen Wilson Jr. brings his grunge-tinged country-folk to Zürich.
events.title: Stephen Wilson Jr.

events.description: Welsh one-man project Strawberry Guy (Alex Stephens) crafts lush, Debussy- and 70s-songwriter-inspired soundscapes with gentle, honest songs. Doors 19:00, start 19:30, support from Malena. Exil is 16+ (under-16s only with a parent), so this is one for the parents.
events.summary: Dreamy bedroom-orchestral indie pop from Strawberry Guy in the cosy Exil club.
events.title: Strawberry Guy

events.description: A true Gold Coast tradition at the Alte Sonne in Obermeilen celebrating 'Suuser' – young fermenting wine served as sweet 'Goofe', lighter 'Wiiber' and stronger 'Manne'. Expect Fischchnusperli and grilled sausages, organ-grinder music and dancing, plus a shooting gallery, children's carousel and strength tester. Saturday runs into the night; Sunday from late morning.
events.summary: Lake Zurich's new-wine fair: sweet 'Suuser' must, fried fish, organ grinders, a kids' carousel and Hau-den-Lukas.
events.title: Suuserchilbi Obermeilen

events.description: Formed in the late 1990s, The Hillbilly Moon Explosion (Emanuela Hutter, Duncan James, Oliver Baroni, Sylvain Petite) blend rock'n'roll with blues, swing, sixties beat, country, surf and chanson. Expect songs from their album 'Back In Time' plus the hits. Doors 19:30, show 20:30. CHF 42 (Moods members half price).
events.summary: Zurich's own rockabilly legends mix rock'n'roll, swing, surf and country for a sharp-dressed Friday night at Moods.
events.title: The Hillbilly Moon Explosion

events.description: Award-winning Irish folk ensemble The Led Farmers headline an 'Irish Night' with support from Scottish ballad singer Larkin / Colin Ramage and a European Champion Irish dancer. Doors 19:00, support 19:30, headliner 20:30, ends around 22:00 – an easy weeknight-style evening. Presale CHF 38 vs CHF 45 at the box office, so buy ahead. 16+ (under-16s only with an adult).
events.summary: All-Ireland champion folk band brings a full-blown Irish trad night – with ballads and Irish dancing – to Plaza Klub.
events.title: Irish Night Zurich with The Led Farmers

events.description: Part of the municipal 'Konzerte in Küsnacht' series: the Kammerorchester Männedorf-Küsnacht joins Trio «tacchi alti» for 'Tiefenrausch' with works by Fauré, Wettstein and Debussy. Free entry with collection; doors 16:30 and seating is limited. An easy family outing right in the village.
events.summary: Local chamber orchestra plays Fauré, Debussy and Wettstein in Küsnacht's reformed church – free, Sunday 5pm.
events.title: 'Tiefenrausch' – Kammerorchester Männedorf-Küsnacht & Trio tacchi alti

events.description: Singer-songwriter Marco Todisco and percussionist Andi Pupato present 'Herzensbrecher', mixing Italian chanson, pop and jazz with storytelling (~110 min incl. interval). Presented by Kulturkreis Herrliberg in the Zehntensaal of the Vogtei. Reservations by phone (044 915 91 43) from 6 Jan 2027; box office and doors from 19:30.
events.summary: Italian cantautore meets star percussionist: melodic, cheeky chanson-pop-jazz in Herrliberg's historic Vogtei.
events.title: Marco Todisco & Andi Pupato – Herzensbrecher

events.description: British soul singer Tony Momrelle fronted acid-jazz band Incognito for over 16 years and has sung with Gloria Estefan, Celine Dion and Janet Jackson before going solo in 2015. His sound mixes 80s synths, jazz keys and big soulful vocals – perfect soul/jazz crossover date night. Show 20:30; CHF 45 (Moods members half price).
events.summary: Former Incognito frontman – 'the Stevie Wonder of the 21st century' – brings silky 80s-tinged soul-jazz to Moods.
events.title: Tony Momrelle

events.description: The Thun singer-songwriter blends alternative pop with soul and rock and has played 500+ shows from Glastonbury to Montreux. Opener Sanaë at 20:00, ends ~22:00. Standing CHF 55, seated CHF 75 (limited), or premium seat + dinner CHF 125 via kaufleuten.ch.
events.summary: Switzerland's Eurovision 2026 singer Veronica Fusaro plays soulful alt-pop in the Klubsaal.
events.title: Veronica Fusaro

events.description: The Lions' Retro Game against Ajoie is also one of the club's designated Lion Kids games, with a family-friendly 15:45 Sunday face-off. Family tickets in sector K1 from CHF 45 (1 adult + 1 child) to CHF 90 for 2 adults + 2 kids; under-6s free.
events.summary: Sunday-afternoon hockey in retro jerseys, flagged as a Lion Kids game – perfect for Liam & Ellie.
events.title: ZSC Lions vs HC Ajoie – Retro Game & Lion Kids Game

events.description: One of the ZSC Lions' three themed home games this season, played in special jerseys. Family tickets (sector K1) make it affordable for the four of you: CHF 90 for 2 adults + 2 kids; under-6s free. Swiss Life Arena is right by Zürich Altstetten station.
events.summary: Special-jersey 'Impact Game' as the Lions host Langnau on a December Saturday at Swiss Life Arena.
events.title: ZSC Lions vs SCL Tigers – Impact Game

events.description: The Zurich Wine Festival runs 12–18 Oct with partner-venue masterclasses early in the week, an Aperitivo Day with wine, food and music on Thu 15 Oct (18–21h, CHF 59), and the main Wine Expo at the Papiersaal on 16–18 Oct (from CHF 35) with 30+ exhibitors; Rioja is the 2026 focus region. New: a Sunday Wine Brunch + Expo (11–14h, CHF 79). English-friendly and a relaxed date-night option.
events.summary: A week of wine in English: 450+ wines, masterclasses, an Aperitivo Day and a Sunday wine brunch at Sihlcity.
events.title: Zurich Wine Festival 2026
